title: Bring the engram-use skill's sync section up to date: memories exchange, memory-aware refresh, and portable sync rules
outcome: Correct the engram-use skill: project memories are exchanged by task sync with --include-memories
acceptance: docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md no longer says project memories are not exchanged; it states that export and import with --include-memories carry current project memories, as shipped

The skill's refresh and exchange procedure works once the data branch holds memories: it never removes the committed memory component before an --include-memories export, and it states the current limit on refreshing changed tasks together with memories

The skill states portable, project-neutral sync rules with no repository names and no quotes: teams sync whenever they judge it useful without asking each time; every code push is followed by a data sync; data stays on its own branch separate from code; the rules grant no code push and the consuming project's own instructions keep the concrete Git authority; it offers a sentence a consuming project can adopt in its instructions
The link check passes through the focused launcher, and the Codex and Claude reviews are clean

completion.summary: Updated the engram-use skill for opt-in memory exchange, memory-safe refresh, and project-neutral sync guidance. Fast-forwarded the reviewed candidate to origin/master and installed its release build. Fresh independent acceptance evaluation passed all four criteria.
